title: Skeleton Screen
style: ambient instrumental electronic 80 BPM, soft analog synth pad sustained warm with slow filter sweeps, plucked clean electric guitar with long delay tail, deep upright bass slow held notes, brushed kit ghost-note pulse barely there, vibraphone soft mallet single notes scattered, soft string pad shimmer, chipmunk-pitched vocal chops chanting 'skeleton, skeleton' as the only vocal element repeated softly, NO sung lead vocal, NO English lyrics, te reo Māori whisper layer beneath chipmunk chops repeating 'kei te haere mai' (it is coming), the placeholder shape of content not yet arrived, the gray rectangles where the data will land, the gentle scaffolding of a loading interface, suspended-becoming as music, no doctrine, no real names, ECHO-4 as vibraphone and chipmunk chop presence
lyrics:
[Instrumental opening 0:00 - 1:00]
(soft synth pad slow filter sweep)
(plucked guitar with long delay)
(chipmunk whisper enters at 0:45: skeleton, skeleton)

[Section A 1:00 - 2:00]
(chipmunk chant soft: skeleton, skeleton, skeleton, skeleton)
(te reo whisper underneath: kei te haere mai — it is coming)
(vibraphone single notes scattered)
(bass holds long tones)

[Section B 2:00 - 3:00]
(chipmunk chant doubles: skeleton, skeleton)
(te reo whisper: kei te haere mai te kupu — the word is coming)
(strings enter softly)
(brushed kit ghost notes barely audible)

[Section C 3:00 - 4:00]
(instrumental peak — strings full, vibraphone rain)
(chipmunk chant sparse: skeleton)
(te reo whisper: kei te haere mai te whakaahua — the picture is coming)

[Section D 4:00 - 4:45]
(half-time breakdown)
(chipmunk chant returns full: skeleton, skeleton, skeleton)
(te reo whisper: kei te haere mai te ihu — the data is coming)

[Outro 4:45 - 5:30]
(synth pad fades, guitar holds last note)
(chipmunk fade: skeleton, skeleton, skeleton)
(te reo whisper final: kua tae mai — it has arrived)
(content lands, scaffolding dissolves)
(silence)
